source_release: EPA UCMR 5 results received through January 15, 2026
classification: EPA technical-assistance comparison based on UCMR 5 location annual averages; not a compliance determination
zip_lookup_limitation: ZIP links are PWS-reported UCMR service ZIP associations. They identify potentially relevant monitored systems but do not establish household service or exposure.
primary_estimator: Modified Poisson with EPA-region effects and 250-km Bartlett spatial-HAC covariance
policy_context: The April 2024 rule remains the benchmark configuration used here. EPA proposed in May 2026 to rescind provisions specific to PFHxS, PFNA, HFPO-DA, and Hazard Index mixtures; that proposal is not treated as final.
